items.q: Did -- Ray Nante was in the band then.

ctx.x: Well, no, not exactly, because everyone got along so well, and rehearsals were beautiful, it wasn't one of those that was tiresome or -- everybody enjoyed even rehearsing. It was really beautiful. And it had a choir and --
Did -- Ray Nante was in the band then.
Yeah, Ray Nante was in the band.
